source.license: No explicit source-repository license established; package MIT license does not apply to source data.

recorded_scope: Retrospective after published results and accidental raw plant-outcome exposure. This protocol precedes retained raw acquisition, formal development fitting and evaluation; it cannot establish unseen outcomes. Preliminary synthetic pilot results were read before this final calibration specification.
question: How accurately do fixed stock-neutrality templates and development-only distribution templates describe the complete normalized count and aboveground dry-mass profiles of five geographically transferred coexisting plant censuses?
objects: Harvested aboveground ramets or inseparable stem clusters within each of ten herbaceous plots; exclude forest and desert allometric masses.

resource.name: Aboveground plant dry mass
resource.cost: q(m)=m is an accounting identity, not a fitted trait or a limiting-resource requirement.
resource.excluded: Roots, soil nutrient availability, external energy budgets, genets and time trajectories.

partition: Five BFEC whole plots development; five RMBL whole plots evaluation. Unequal habitat composition and only two geographic locales; not independent regional replication or a blinded holdout.

domain.lower_rationale: Ten times the published nearest-0.001g weighing precision; source masses are used as recorded, without imposing rounding.
domain.upper_rule: 10 raised to ceil(log10(max positive finite development mass)); includes the development maximum. No evaluation mass enters domain selection.
domain.endpoint_rule: [left,right) except last bin includes upper. All empty bins retained.
domain.coverage: Retain raw row membership and mass tokens; missing/unparseable/nonfinite/nonpositive entries excluded with reason. Positive masses below lower or above upper excluded from scored profiles but counted and summed in whole-plot coverage.

models.log_neutral: Count density proportional to m^-2 on the frozen domain; normalized expected-stock shares equal logarithmic bin widths / log-domain width.
models.linear_neutral: Count density proportional to m^-1; normalized expected-stock shares equal linear bin widths / linear-domain width.
models.empirical: Equal-plot mean development count histogram, with predeclared Jeffreys 0.5 pseudocount per bin in each plot for count log loss; equal-plot mean mass profile without pseudocount. Count and mass are separate descriptive templates, not one generative population model.
models.bounded_pareto: Count m^-alpha, alpha in [-2,4]. Fit equal-plot average per-object continuous loglikelihood within frozen domain with deterministic scalar optimizer.
models.bounded_weibull: Truncated Weibull count density. Shape [0.1,5], scale [lower/100,upper*100]. Fit equal-plot average per-object continuous loglikelihood with deterministic fixed multistart optimizer; exact initializations/termination and numerical integration are frozen by the implementation source checkpoint.

fitting: No evaluation plot is passed into fit_forecasts. Continuous likelihood for recorded source masses is an approximation to weighing; synthetic rounding sensitivity is retained. Any plot with no positive in-domain mass is an explicit eligibility failure; do not silently reweight plots. Optimizer failure aborts instead of selecting an evaluation-dependent fallback.

scores.primary: Equal-evaluation-plot mean TV between realized normalized mass profile and each normalized expected-stock/descriptive template. Descriptive template discrepancy; it does not estimate expected normalized census-share prediction error without an observation law.
secondary: Equal-plot mean per-object binned negative log probability
Equal-plot average and pooled-mass resource profiles shown separately
scores.comparisons: Retain all model scores, rank by primary mean TV, report per-plot paired differences and strict-majority wins; no arbitrary significance or improvement threshold. Ties retained.
scores.zero_probability: If an occupied observed count bin has zero predicted probability, retain infinite log loss as null with an explicit infinite flag in JSON; never epsilon clip.

calibration.reference_stream: SeedSequence([seed,n,0]); independent rounded IID alpha=2 null replicates supply 95% TV quantile.
calibration.evaluation_stream: SeedSequence([seed,n,block,int(alpha*100),1]); perfect repeated blocks, final block truncated to n.
calibration.estimands: Exact rounded expected count/stock profiles; realized TV distribution, mean normalized share bias, empty-bin fractions, and independent-reference IID-envelope exceedance with Wilson Monte Carlo intervals. Conditional on fixed census count; perfect blocks are stress scenarios, not identified plant dependence.
calibration.decision: Actual ecological neutrality remains unresolved because inclusion/dependence, count-mass dependence and regional replication are not calibrated. The 95% IID null envelope is a synthetic sampling diagnostic, not practical equivalence or a plant verdict.

excluded_claims: Unseen or externally preregistered plant outcomes
Equivalence inferred from non-rejection or a fitted near-zero slope
statistical_scope: Five evaluation plots nested within one locale; point template discrepancies, no ecological significance/equivalence claim.
